cohort: The study included mothers giving birth at an Independent Midwifery Practice (IMP), divided into a treatment group (managed delivery environment) and a control group (unmanaged delivery environment).
finding: The study found that there is a positive influence of the delivery environment setting on the progress of labor, with mothers in an unmanaged delivery environment having 3.67 times the risk of experiencing cervical opening < 1 cm/hour compared to those in a managed environment.
